problem.title: DiLO KITTI Odom seq 07 full: comparison with the paper's KITTI table
problem.question: How close is the DiLO reimplementation to the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry translational error (official RTE)?

variants.label: DiLO, default parameters
variants.intent: Profile used for the repository's KITTI full-sequence runs (see the method README).
variants.note: DiLO: direct frame-to-keyframe LiDAR odometry via spherical-range-image projective data association (no NN search) + point-to-plane GN; constant-velocity prior, no GT seed. lookup_radius=1 lookup_max_dist=1.50 keyframes=304
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.

variants.label: DiLO, dense profile
variants.intent: Profile used for the repository's KITTI full-sequence runs (see the method README).
variants.note: DiLO: direct frame-to-keyframe LiDAR odometry via spherical-range-image projective data association (no NN search) + point-to-plane GN; constant-velocity prior, no GT seed. lookup_radius=1 lookup_max_dist=1.50 keyframes=303
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Close enough to the current default to keep as a live alternative.

variants.label: DiLO paper odometry (plane key points, 10-frame window, pairwise averaging)
variants.intent: Sec. 3 of the paper without edge key points: 192x2048 sin-elevation range image with vertical fill, Farid-filter normals, eleven planarity-weighted key-point lists, eq. 18 residual, Algorithm 1 with N = 10 and 5 update iterations. Compare with DiLO-plane in Table 1.
variants.note: DiLO paper odometry (192x2048 sin-elevation range image with vertical fill, Farid-filter normals, 11 planarity-weighted key-point lists x 100, window of 10 frames, 5 pairwise-averaging iterations; plane key points only); poses after leaving the window; no GT seed.
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: DiLO paper odometry + 0.22 deg beam correction
variants.intent: paper_odometry on scans with the KITTI vertical-angle correction (the paper does not mention it).
variants.note: DiLO paper odometry (192x2048 sin-elevation range image with vertical fill, Farid-filter normals, 11 planarity-weighted key-point lists x 100, window of 10 frames, 5 pairwise-averaging iterations; plane key points only); poses after leaving the window; no GT seed.
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: DiLO paper odometry without the window re-estimation
variants.intent: Only the Huber registration of each new frame to the last 10 frames (Algorithm 1 without the update loop).
variants.note: DiLO paper odometry (192x2048 sin-elevation range image with vertical fill, Farid-filter normals, 11 planarity-weighted key-point lists x 100, window of 10 frames, 0 pairwise-averaging iterations; plane key points only); poses after leaving the window; no GT seed.
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: DiLO paper pipeline + spread planar key points + slope-aware vertical fill + 0.18 deg correction
variants.intent: Planarity > 0.98 and at most one key point per 8 x 8 px cell per list (the ground list clustered ahead of the car, the side lists on vegetation, so roll was barely constrained), a vertical fill that no longer puts the far ground under the road (fill_slope 0.1), and the 0.18 deg correction that zeroes the pitch bias once the fill is fixed. Chosen on 07 windows, 00 windows held out (see papers/dilo/README.md).
variants.note: DiLO paper odometry (192x2048 sin-elevation range image with vertical fill, Farid-filter normals, 11 planarity-weighted key-point lists x 100, window of 10 frames, 5 pairwise-averaging iterations; plane key points only); poses after leaving the window; no GT seed.
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Close enough to the current default to keep as a live alternative.
